purpose: Single registry of the platform capability cores tracked by CAPABILITY-CORES-NOT-WIRED. A core is 'wired' only when a named non-test production consumer imports it. The guard ratchets on this file: a wired core may never silently lose its consumer, and a pending core may never be described as wired without one.
not_this: This registry is NOT about optional feature activation (ml_pest_detection, ml_yield_prediction, ml_field_boundary, aquacrop_salinity). Those are governed separately and share only the word 'capability'. Conflating them would mark this gap closed while these cores remain orphaned.
